project_subtitle: School Result Processing and GPA Engine

team_members.name: Kawsar
team_members.contribution: Core result engine architecture, backend REST APIs, official fixture importer, Stitch UI reproduction, and test suites

R1.name: Student dataset and subject setup
R1.evidence: MongoDB models (Student, Mark, Subject, Class, Case) hosting 1,765 total students across 25 public cases (PUB-01 to PUB-25) with 6 compulsory subjects and 1 optional 4th subject per student. Route: /students

R2.name: Result calculation
R2.evidence: Pure TypeScript grading engine (backend/src/services/resultEngine/) implementing exact standard grade scale (80+ 5.0, 70-79 4.0, 60-69 3.5, 50-59 3.0, 40-49 2.0, 33-39 1.0, <33 0.0), practical rules (theory >= 25/75, practical >= 8/25), optional bonus max(0, GP - 2) over fixed divisor 6, compulsory failure override to 0.00 (F), and preserved uncancelled GPA. Verified by 13 unit tests. Route: /results

R3.name: Per-student calculation trace
R3.evidence: CalculationTraceView component providing step-by-step breakdown of concrete marks, subject statuses, rule citations (R-11, R-12, R-13), raw GPA, override explanations, and real-time Edit Marks modal recalculation. Route: /students/[id]

R4.name: Checking lists
R4.evidence: Three independent checking lists: Optional Checking (GP <= 2.0 or AB), Practical Fail (Practical < 8/25), and Absent Review (AB in any subject). Multi-list membership supported with direct links to student audit traces. Route: /checking-lists

sample_data.cases_supported: PUB-01 through PUB-25 (25 cases, 1,765 total students)
sample_data.reset_instructions: cd backend && npm run seed:fixture (or npm run seed:reset)

ai_tools_used.used_for: Initial screen design layout and UI design token export
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Visual review and manual CSS/Tailwind alignment against Stitch design specifications

ai_tools_used.used_for: Implementation pair-programming for deterministic result engine, Next.js frontend pages, REST APIs, and Vitest test suites
ai_tools_used.how_output_was_verified: Automated Vitest unit test suite (13/13 passed), Next.js production build verification (0 errors), and live browser subagent end-to-end testing

major_design_decisions: Implemented a pure deterministic calculation engine decoupled from the database layer for 100% testability and sub-millisecond execution.
Utilized compound unique indexes ({ caseId: 1, studentId: 1 }) to seamlessly support all 25 official P08 public fixture cases concurrently.
Preserved mathematically uncancelled GPA alongside compulsory failure overrides to provide full academic transparency in calculation traces.
Built a real-time CaseContext selector in Next.js frontend allowing instant dataset switching across all pages without page reloads.
known_limitations: Official marksheet export utilizes browser-native print layout (@media print) rather than server-side headless PDF generation.
Authentication and multi-tenant role-based access control (RBAC) are omitted as per hackathon specification.
